question: If S-104's next RM-221 shipment ships two weeks late, when will DC-EAST run out of Lacrivia, when will supply recover there, and which customers get supply first under our allocation rules?
answer:
## Answer

**1. When DC-EAST runs out: about 26–27 September 2026, so it's already out. The two-week slip doesn't change this date.**

| Pack | On hand (9/25 snapshot) | Safety stock | Average demand, last 13 weeks | Days of stock left | Out of stock on |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lacrivia 5 mL (FG-1001) | 46 | 471 | 244 units/week | about 1.3 | about 9/26 |
| Lacrivia 10 mL (FG-1002) | 34 | 233 | 117 units/week | about 2.0 | about 9/27 |

Both packs have been below safety stock since 9/11, and no restock shows up in DC-EAST's inventory.

**2. When supply recovers: about 10 December 2026, two weeks later than the on-time date of 26 November.**
- The next RM-221 order from S-104 is PO005791: 4,200 units, promised to ship 10/07, still open. Two weeks late means it ships **10/21**.
- From there it takes **50 days** to reach DC-EAST. This uses the standard stage times held in the knowledge layer:

| Stage | Days | Cumulative |
|---|---|---|
| Ships to S-201's site | 6 | 6 |
| Emulsifier premix CMP-310 (made, tested, shipped) | 10 | 16 |
| Emulsion concentrate SEMI-031 | 4 | 20 |
| Bulk emulsion SEMI-044 | 8 | 28 |
| Bottle fill | 3 | 31 |
| Final release, including the 14-day sterility test, plus 4 days to the DC | 19 | 50 |

- That leaves DC-EAST out of stock for about **74 days (around 10.5 weeks), or about 3,800 units of unmet demand**.
- Caveat: RM-221 comes from one qualified supplier. It also feeds Cyclosporine OS 0.05% and 11 lens-care products, so not all of this order will go to Lacrivia.

**3. Who gets supply first (allocation rule BR-ALLOC-01)**
- I ranked customers on Lacrivia prescriptions (TRx) from sites in DC-EAST's states, over the 13 weeks ending 9/25.
- Each clinic is counted under its parent health system and gets that system's contract tier.

| Priority | Customer | 13-week TRx |
|---|---|---|
| 1 – Tier A contract | Riverbend Health System (AC00059) | 836 |
| 1 – Tier A contract | Oak Hollow Health System (AC00038) | 708 |
| 1 – Tier A contract | Northfield Health System (AC00117) | 533 |
| 2 – Tier B contract | Clearview Health System (AC00001) | 530 |
| 2 – Tier B contract | Sunridge Health System (AC00138) | 428 |
| 3 – Everyone else, split in proportion to TRx (2,135 TRx in total) | Brightwater 19.4%, Stonegate 15.0%, Sunridge Vision Associates 20 9.3%, Willow Creek 8.8%, Harbor Point VA 2 6.5%, Highland VA 26 6.2%, then 12 smaller independent clinics | |

Independent clinics such as "Sunridge Vision Associates 20" have no parent health system, so they don't get their namesake system's tier.

**What else you can do**
- **No company substitute:** Cyclosporine OS is made from the same RM-221 supply, so it can't cover the gap (rule BR-SUB-01). Medical Affairs would guide other treatment options.
- **Transfer from other DCs:** DC-CENTRAL and DC-WEST together hold about 695 units of 5 mL and 391 units of 10 mL above safety stock. That's roughly 2.8 weeks of DC-EAST demand. Moving it needs formal Supply Planning approval.

## Sources and assumptions
- **Sources:**
  - Supply-chain trace for S-104 / RM-221 and the standard lead times, from the knowledge layer.
  - Business rules: BR-ALLOC-01 (allocation), BR-LEAD-01 (recovery lead time), BR-CUST-01 (what counts as a customer), BR-REGION-01 (which DC serves which states), BR-SUB-01 (substitutes).
  - Reference lists for DC service regions and supply contracts.
  - Supply data: PURCH_ORD, DC_INV and WHSLR_SHIP tables.
  - Commercial data: prescriptions (RXT_WKLY), prescribers and accounts.
  - The data-use policy check allowed all of this for your role with no masking.
- **Assumptions:**
  - Demand is measured by shipments from DC-EAST to wholesalers.
  - There's no table of incoming finished goods. I assumed earlier RM-221 orders already moving through production don't restock DC-EAST before PO005791 arrives, since its inventory has fallen steadily for seven weeks.
  - Lead times are standard times with no expediting.
  - A site is served by DC-EAST if its own state is in DC-EAST's region.
- The decision was logged as trace b8205056.

sql.sql: SELECT PO_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, MATERIAL_ID, ORDER_DT, PROMISED_SHIP_DT, ACTUAL_SHIP_DT, QTY, STATUS FROM dbo.PURCH_ORD WHERE SUPPLIER_ID='S-104' AND MATERIAL_ID='RM-221' AND (STATUS <> 'CLOSED' OR PROMISED_SHIP_DT >= '2026-08-01') ORDER BY PROMISED_SHIP_DT

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT, ON_HAND_UNITS, SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT >= '2026-07-01' ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, SNAPSHOT_DT

SELECT MATERIAL_ID, DATEADD(week, DATEDIFF(week, 0, SHIP_DT), 0) AS WK, SUM(UNITS) AS UNITS, COUNT(*) AS N FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SHIP_DT >= '2026-06-15' GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, DATEADD(week, DATEDIFF(week, 0, SHIP_DT), 0) ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, WK

SELECT MATERIAL_ID, SHIP_DT, SUM(UNITS) AS UNITS FROM dbo.WHSLR_SHIP WHERE DC_ID='DC-EAST' AND MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SHIP_DT >= '2026-08-31' GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, SHIP_DT ORDER BY MATERIAL_ID, SHIP_DT

WITH wks AS (SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY ORDER BY WK_END_DT DESC LIMIT 13),
a AS (SELECT a.ACCOUNT_ID, a.STATE, a.ACCT_TYP,
        COALESCE(gp.ACCOUNT_ID, p.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_ID) AS TOP_ID
      FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT a
      LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT p ON a.PARENT_ACCOUNT_ID = p.ACCOUNT_ID
      LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT gp ON p.PARENT_ACCOUNT_ID = gp.ACCOUNT_ID),
rx AS (SELECT r.PROD_NDC11, pr.ACCOUNT_ID, SUM(r.TRX_QTY) TRX
       FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r JOIN wks ON r.WK_END_DT = wks.WK_END_DT
       JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER pr ON r.PRSCRBR_ME = pr.PRSCRBR_ME
       WHERE r.PROD_NDC11 IN ('99101010105','99101010110')
       GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT a.TOP_ID, t.ACCOUNT_NM AS TOP_NM, t.ACCT_TYP AS TOP_TYP,
  CASE a.TOP_ID WHEN 'AC00117' THEN 'A' WHEN 'AC00038' THEN 'A' WHEN 'AC00059' THEN 'A' WHEN 'AC00001' THEN 'B' WHEN 'AC00138' THEN 'B' ELSE 'None' END AS TIER,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCOUNT_ID) AS EAST_SITES,
  SUM(IFF(rx.PROD_NDC11='99101010105', rx.TRX,0)) AS TRX_5ML,
  SUM(IFF(rx.PROD_NDC11='99101010110', rx.TRX,0)) AS TRX_10ML,
  SUM(rx.TRX) AS TRX_13W,
  (SELECT MIN(WK_END_DT)||' to '||MAX(WK_END_DT) FROM wks) AS WINDOW
FROM rx JOIN a ON rx.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.ACCOUNT t ON t.ACCOUNT_ID = a.TOP_ID
WHERE a.STATE IN ('NY','NJ','PA','MA','FL','GA','NC','OH')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY CASE TIER WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, TRX_13W DESC

SELECT DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID, ON_HAND_UNITS, SAFETY_STOCK_UNITS FROM dbo.DC_INV WHERE MATERIAL_ID IN ('FG-1001','FG-1002') AND SNAPSHOT_DT = (SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT_DT) FROM dbo.DC_INV) ORDER BY DC_ID, MATERIAL_ID
